lots.title: Ely Library Services - Engage, Design and Fit Out Contract
lots.description: Single-lot engage, design and fit out contract for the refresh of Ely Library's public offer. The Supplier provides design engagement (site visit, stakeholder consultation), prepares initial design proposals, incorporates one round of Authority feedback, and then delivers and installs furniture, signage and carpet per the approved final design. The Authority is Cambridgeshire County Council; Authority Premises and Assets are defined in Schedule 11 and the underlying Find a Tender reference is pending insertion in Background (A). Schedule 1 (Specification) is a stub in this draft contract and refers back to the separately issued specification pack (Appendix 4).
requirements: Provide the Services with reasonable care and skill and in accordance with Best Industry Practice (clause 4.2(a)).
Ensure all goods, materials, standards and techniques used in providing the Services are of the best quality and free from defects in workmanship, installation and design (clause 4.2(b)).
Obtain, maintain and comply with all Necessary Consents at the Supplier's own cost (clause 4.2(c)).

Undertake all design engagement activities required by the Authority, including site visit at Ely Library, stakeholder consultation, initial design proposals and one round of Authority feedback incorporated into revised proposals (clause 4.3).

Ensure all design proposals comply with applicable accessibility standards, including dementia-friendly and autism-friendly design principles aligned with the Authority's sustainability objectives (clause 4.4).
Do not commence manufacture, delivery or installation of any items until the Authority provides written approval of the final design (clause 4.5).
Deliver and install all furniture, signage, carpet and any associated items in accordance with the approved design and any installation requirements specified by the Authority (clause 4.6).

Prior to commencing works, prepare and submit Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) specific to Ely Library, taking into account first-floor access constraints, delivery windows and other site-specific requirements; do not begin works until the Authority reviews and approves the RAMS in writing (clause 4.7).
Comply with all applicable Law and the Authority's Mandatory Policies; maintain records necessary to evidence compliance (clause 5.1).
Perform obligations in accordance with all applicable health and safety Law and the Authority's Health and Safety Policy whilst at the Authority Premises (clause 5.2).
Comply with applicable equality Law and the Authority's equality and diversity policy; take all necessary steps to prevent unlawful discrimination (clauses 5.4(a)-(b)).
Comply with applicable environmental Law, including waste disposal and handling of hazardous and toxic materials (clause 6.1).

Implement and maintain carbon-reduction measures consistent with the Authority's Climate Charter, including energy-efficient practices, reduced fossil-fuel usage, and prioritisation of low-carbon technologies, materials and transport options (clause 6.2(b)).
Implement and maintain waste-minimisation measures ensuring waste is prevented, reduced, reused or recycled wherever reasonably practicable (clause 6.2(c)).
Provide, on request, evidence demonstrating carbon-reduction and waste-minimisation measures, including records, plans, policies, audits or reporting information (clause 6.2(d)).

At exit, provide the Authority with full documentation of all materials, components, equipment and associated warranties (including manufacturer warranties, maintenance instructions, compliance certificates); deliver an in-person handover including on-site training for Authority Personnel (clauses 7.9(a)-(c)).
Maintain a Disaster Recovery Plan, test it at least once every 12 months, and implement it if the Services are unavailable for more than 10 days (clauses 8.1, 8.2, 8.4).
Invoice only on completion of the three defined milestones: Design approval; Delivery of goods to site; Completion of installation and handover (clause 9.4).

Submit invoices in PDF by email to ccc.invoices@cambridgeshire.gov.uk with a valid Purchase Order number and in a form that complies with the standard for electronic invoicing (clauses 9.4(a)-(c), 9.5).

Maintain Required Insurances for the duration of the contract and for 6 years post-expiry: public liability £5m, employer's liability £10m (or as legally required), professional indemnity £2m, product liability £5m (clauses 19.1, 19.5).

Comply with Data Protection Legislation (UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018); act as Processor to the Authority's Controller; notify the Authority of any Personal Data breach within 72 hours (clauses 21.1, 21.2, 21.4(g)).
